# Parquet fixtures

Real ingester output for testing the analytics layer without MinIO. Every
coordinate here is **synthetic** (generated by `meshgen`), not from a real network.

| Directory | Path hash size | receptions | adverts |
|-----------|----------------|-----------:|--------:|
| `sea-seed1-2h-hash1/` | 1 byte (default, hop hashes collide) | 75,571 | 13,945 |
| `sea-seed1-2h-hash3/` | 3 bytes (practically no collisions) | 75,571 | 13,945 |

Each directory holds `receptions/` and `adverts/` Hive partitions
(`region=SEA/date=YYYY-MM-DD/hour=HH/`) exactly as the ingester writes them, one
file per hour, plus `truth.json`: the ground-truth network (nodes, positions,
links) from the same `meshgen` run. Receptions spill into `hour=02` because
relays of packets sent just before the 2 h mark are heard after it.

## How they were made

From `ingest/` (run in `golang:1.27.3-bookworm` via Docker because Windows
Application Control blocked the freshly built binaries; natively the commands
are the same). The intermediate NDJSON goes to the system temp dir, not the repo.

```sh
for h in 1 3; do
  D=../testdata/parquet/sea-seed1-2h-hash$h; mkdir -p $D
  go run ./cmd/meshgen -seed 1 -duration 2h -rate 30 -hash-size $h \
    -out /tmp/sea-seed1-2h-hash$h.ndjson -truth $D/truth.json
  go run ./cmd/ingester -mode replay -replay-file /tmp/sea-seed1-2h-hash$h.ndjson \
    -local-dir $D -flush-rows 1000000 -http-addr 127.0.0.1:0
done
```

`meshgen` is deterministic for a given seed, so rerunning reproduces the same
rows (file names are a hash of the rows).
